title: p10k-rs prompt --json payload (v1)
description: Structured snapshot of one `p10k-rs prompt` render. Emitted by `p10k-rs prompt --json` for AI hosts, integration partners, and debugging tools. The shape is wire-stable within the `p10krs.prompt/v1` schema version; breaking changes ship behind a new schema version (`v2`, etc.) while keeping the v1 file present for at least one minor cycle.

schema_version.description: Stable schema identifier — always the literal string `p10krs.prompt/v1` for payloads validated by this document.

produced_at_unix.description: Unix epoch seconds at the moment the binary started assembling the payload. Useful for detecting stale snapshots vs. the live shell state.

p10k_rs_version.description: Cargo package version of the running `p10k-rs` binary. Matches the value emitted by `p10k-rs version --json`'s `binary` field.

shell.description: Which shell asked for the prompt. Lowercase CLI label.

exit_status.description: Exit status the shell forwarded via `--last-status`. Defaults to 0 when the shell didn't pass one (consistent with the clap default).

host.description: Detected AI / agent host the shell is running inside. `null` when no host was detected. The set is open: unknown agents that adopt the `AI_AGENT` / `AGENT` convention are surfaced as their (trimmed, lowercased) self-reported name.

cwd.description: Current working directory at render time, UTF-8 string (lossy for non-UTF-8 filesystems, matching the `dir` segment's rendering).

ansi_text.description: Full rendered prompt for the requested side with ANSI escapes included. Byte-identical to what `p10k-rs prompt` (without `--json`) would print to stdout for the same `--render-side`.

plain_text.description: `ansi_text` with ANSI SGR/OSC escapes and zsh's `%{`/`%}` non-printing markers stripped. Drop-in for log lines, file names, and other plain-text consumers.

left.description: Per-segment breakdown for the left ribbon, after `disabled` / `show_in_dir` / `show_on_command` gating but before powerline-arrow weaving.

right.description: Per-segment breakdown for the right ribbon. Same shape as `left`.

git.description: Git state for the cwd, when available. `null` outside a git repository or when none of the configured backends (gitstatusd, ShellOut, GixBackend) could produce a state.

name.description: Segment identifier — matches the TOML config key (`Segment::name`). Stable across releases.

ansi.description: Segment's styled output as it would appear in the prompt ribbon, ANSI escapes included. Does not include the powerline arrows or separators the renderer weaves between adjacent segments — those are owned by the render pipeline, not the segment.

plain.description: `ansi` with ANSI escapes and zsh non-printing markers stripped.

state.description: Optional state tag the segment reported (`ok`, `error`, `writable`, …). `null` when the segment doesn't carry state.

icon.description: Glyph the segment chose for its icon slot, when applicable. `null` when the segment has no icon.

background.description: Background colour the segment painted itself on. `null` when the segment opted out of a background. Encoded as a `Color`: named string (`"blue"`), hex literal (`"#ff6600"`), ANSI palette index (0–255), or `[r, g, b]` triple — matching the config-file colour grammar.

branch.description: Current branch name. Empty string when detached or unknown.

ahead.description: Commits ahead of the configured upstream. 0 if no upstream or unknown.

behind.description: Commits behind the configured upstream. 0 if no upstream or unknown.

has_conflicts.description: `true` if any path is in conflict (unmerged stage).

action.description: In-progress repo action — one of `merge`, `rebase`, `cherry-pick`, `revert`, `bisect` — or `null` when the working tree is in a normal state.
